about.title: Genuine parts, honest answers
paragraphs: We do such a high volume of genuine Subaru parts that we can sell them for less than our competitors, often less than others charge for cheap, after-market parts.

We often give you the option to buy genuine Subaru parts or, if appropriate, after-market parts. It's your choice. But you'll never pay for genuine Subaru parts and get inferior after-market parts. That's just not right.
Our loyal customers are our best advertising. Key drop boxes and envelopes are available for after-hours drop off.

services.name: Oil Changes
services.blurb: Drop it off for 4 hours, no appointment needed.
services.intro: If you're dropping off a Subaru, Honda or Toyota for an oil change and can leave it for 4 working hours, you don't need to call or email. Drop it after 9am and we'll have it ready by 2pm. Please call ahead two days before or after a major holiday, or if you need more than an oil change.
